steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; $pages = array('Home','Divisions','About','Gallery','Contact'); $ids = array(); foreach ($pages as $title) { $existing = get_page_by_path(sanitize_title($title)); if ($existing) { $ids[$title] = $existing->ID; continue; } $ids[$title] = wp_insert_post(array('post_title'=>$title,'post_name'=>sanitize_title($title),'post_type'=>'page','post_status'=>'publish','post_content'=>'')); } update_option('show_on_front','page'); update_option('page_on_front',$ids['Home']); foreach ($ids as $title=>$id) { update_post_meta($id,'_wp_page_template','default'); }
